sourceKind: Located existing/new implementation paths; source presence is not full acceptance.

records.title: Connect product and business intelligence
originalAcceptance: Recommendations reference real evidence and measurable business objectives.
Sensitive business/customer data has scoped access and retention.

discovery.title: Connect product and business intelligence
discovery.finding: Generic memory, decision records and lexical source search are implemented. Business Intelligence, Customer Analytics and Revenue Optimization are specialist/catalog names. No typed customer/financial observations, objective-linked recommendation engine or scoped business ingestion path was found.

criteria.requirement: Recommendations reference real evidence and measurable business objectives.
criteria.observed: Generic record citations are available, but no business recommendation is tied to real product/customer evidence and measurable business objectives.

criteria.requirement: Sensitive business/customer data has scoped access and retention.
criteria.observed: The owner-private workspace is not a business-data retention or per-source access implementation; no business-specific retention policy is executed.

discovery.nextAction: Add minimal typed objective/observation records and authorized sources, including explicit retention and evidence-linked recommendations.

records.title: Build innovation discovery and validation
originalAcceptance: Proposals include sources, competing solutions, validation plans and experimental results.
The system does not claim that nobody has built something without evidence.

discovery.title: Build innovation discovery and validation
discovery.finding: An Innovation Discovery specialist and a UI note directing users to save research exist. The note explicitly avoids assuming novelty, revenue or patent eligibility. No enforced proposal/competitor/experiment-result lifecycle exists.

criteria.requirement: Proposals include sources, competing solutions, validation plans and experimental results.
criteria.observed: Generic Research memory can hold text but does not require sources, competing solutions, validation plans or measured experiment results.

criteria.requirement: The system does not claim that nobody has built something without evidence.
criteria.observed: The UI explicitly says novelty, revenue and patent eligibility are not assumed. This wording is not a complete constraint on model-generated innovation claims.

discovery.nextAction: Build a small evidence-gated opportunity lifecycle with alternatives, experiment metrics, stop criteria and retained failed outcomes.

records.title: Implement scoped compliance and legal auditing
originalAcceptance: Reports distinguish measured controls, missing evidence and legal interpretation.
No unsupported certification or legal conclusion is issued.

discovery.title: Implement scoped compliance and legal auditing
discovery.finding: Compliance and Legal Auditing are source-review specialists. jobs.ts explicitly records an unqualified-tool capability gap for Legal Auditing, and the analyzer scope excludes legal certification. No jurisdiction/control evidence collector or legal interpretation workflow was found.

criteria.requirement: Reports distinguish measured controls, missing evidence and legal interpretation.
criteria.observed: Generic model review and capability-gap output do not implement control measurement, missing-evidence collection and jurisdiction-aware legal interpretation.

criteria.requirement: No unsupported certification or legal conclusion is issued.
criteria.observed: Analyzer and job scopes avoid claiming legal certification; complete legal report output and qualified-review checks are still missing.

discovery.nextAction: Implement scoped control/evidence reports from selected standards and jurisdictions, clearly separating measurement from qualified interpretation.

records.title: Resolve the unused Vercel experiment
originalAcceptance: No unwanted running resources or required Vercel dependency remain.
Cleanup outcome is verified; absence of a supported delete operation is documented.

discovery.title: Resolve the unused Vercel experiment
discovery.finding: Read-only live project listing found omnidev-swarm-workers (prj_OZBr4Fx6d6scl4ItWShgKhLqdu4S). Explicit team-scoped project, deployment and sandbox-session reads all returned 403 authorization required. No cleanup or resource mutation was attempted; resource absence cannot be inferred from failed reads.

criteria.requirement: No unwanted running resources or required Vercel dependency remain.
criteria.observed: Source/runtime manifest shows the worker is portable without a required Vercel package, but current external deployments and sessions cannot be inspected under the missing team authorization.

criteria.requirement: Cleanup outcome is verified; absence of a supported delete operation is documented.
criteria.observed: No cleanup outcome can be verified until authorized provider read-back succeeds. Existing empty-project history is retained; no unsupported delete claim is made.

discovery.nextAction: Authorize the existing Vercel connection for team_zFlY4R3xpeYx8IaL1p8mOn8b; inspect the exact project before any owner-authorized archive/removal.

sourceSearch.limitations: Name-based search plus inspected entrypoints; a matching specialist name or dependency reference is not an operational adapter.

criteria.requirement: Authorized real-source discovery and incremental read-back are demonstrated.

discovery.nextAction: Implement and authorize a minimal read-only Adobe XD adapter, demonstrate incremental read-back plus denial/revocation/service-failure handling, then separately qualify any writes.
